Mumbai Property Registrations Expected to Hit 14-Year High

Mumbai's property market is projected to see an 11% increase in registrations in August, potentially reaching a 14-year high. The market has shown a sustained strong performance, with projections indicating it could achieve its best-ever August figures. This trend suggests continued robust activity in the city's real estate sector.
